name: AI Token & Cost Calculator
description: Calculates exact token counts and estimated API costs for popular LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama 3) in real-time.
target_audience: AI developers, prompt engineers, content creators, and agencies standardizing LLM usage costs.

how_to_build.core_logic: Integrate client-side tokenizers like 'js-tiktoken' or lightweight BPE algorithms. Maintain a local JSON lookup dictionary for price-per-1k-tokens across different models (Input vs Output). Calculate token length on every 'input' event and multiply by rates.

name: AI Prompt Anonymizer / PII Scrubber
description: Scubs emails, phone numbers, IP addresses, credit cards, and names from text prompts before sending them to AI models.
target_audience: Enterprise workers, lawyers, healthcare workers, and GDPR-conscious European users.

how_to_build.core_logic: Use regex patterns for structural PII (emails, IPs, SSNs, phone numbers, credit card Luhn validation). Use a lightweight NLP library like Compromise.js to detect Proper Nouns (names, organizations). Replace matched strings with tokens like [NAME_1], [EMAIL_1] and provide a 'Copy Clean Prompt' button.

name: AI Text Diff & Revision Inspector
description: Highlights side-by-side or inline structural differences, hallucinated additions, and omitted words between original drafts and AI outputs.
target_audience: Editors, copywriters, academics, and proofreaders comparing LLM iterations.

how_to_build.core_logic: Import the popular client-side 'diff' library (jsdiff). Accept Text A (Original) and Text B (AI Output). Run 'Diff.diffWords()' or 'Diff.diffLines()'. Render colored additions (green) and deletions (red) in a split or unified visual pane.

name: Prompt Markdown & System Prompt Formatter
description: Transforms messy raw text prompts into clean, structured Markdown or XML-tagged system prompts (e.g., <context>, <rules>, <output_format>).
target_audience: Prompt engineers, AI developers, and automation builders.

how_to_build.core_logic: Accept unstructured text or section inputs. Provide templates for XML-style prompt structure (<instructions>, <context>, <examples>). Auto-indent, clean trailing whitespace, and wrap variable placeholders (e.g. {{variable}}).

name: AI Buzzword & Overuse Detector
description: Scans text for stereotypical AI-generated words and phrases (e.g. 'delve', 'testament', 'tapestry', 'pivotal', 'game-changer') and flags them.
target_audience: SEO writers, blog editors, marketing professionals, and students aiming for natural language.

how_to_build.core_logic: Maintain an array of known AI-overused words and transitional phrases. Scan text on keyup/paste using regex with word boundaries (\b). Highlight matches inline with CSS markers and show an AI Density Score percentage.

name: LinkedIn Post Preview & Break Formatter
description: Formats LinkedIn posts with proper line breaks, emojis, and previews exactly where the '...see more' fold will appear on desktop and mobile.
target_audience: LinkedIn creators, ghostwriters, founders, and digital marketers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Measure character limits and line breaks. Emulate LinkedIn's truncation threshold (approx. 140-210 characters depending on screen width/lines). Render live SVG phone/desktop mockups updating dynamically.

name: Bionic Reading Text Converter
description: Converts plain text into Bionic Reading format by bolding the first few letters of every word to facilitate faster reading comprehension.
target_audience: Students, researchers, speed readers, and people with ADHD/dyslexia.

how_to_build.core_logic: Split text by spaces and words. For each word, calculate fixation points (e.g. Math.ceil(word.length * 0.4)). Wrap the first half in <b> tags and the remaining in <span>. Output formatted HTML or Rich Text.

name: TikTok & YouTube Shorts Script Timer
description: Calculates the exact duration of a spoken video script based on average speaking pace (slow, conversational, fast, fast-caption style).
target_audience: Short-form video creators, YouTubers, podcasters, and advertisers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Count words and estimated pauses based on punctuation (commas = 0.3s, periods = 0.6s). Divide total words by WPM (Words Per Minute) settings (e.g., 130 WPM conversational, 160 WPM fast). Optionally use Web Speech API to test-read it aloud.

name: Social Media Bio Link Decorator & Safety Checker
description: Generates fancy unicode fonts for Instagram/X bios while testing for characters that trigger spam filters or accessibility screen reader issues.
target_audience: Influencers, marketers, brand managers, and social media managers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Map ASCII character codes to specific Unicode mathematical blocks (Bold, Script, Fraktur, Monospace, Fullwidth). Check against accessibility guidelines (flag invisible/unsupported glyphs).

name: UTC / Remote Team Time-Zone Visualizer Strip
description: Provides an interactive visual timeline comparing overlapping working hours across multiple global time zones (EST, PST, CET, UTC, GMT, IST).
target_audience: Remote workers, distributed engineering teams, digital nomads, and project managers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Convert local time or target meeting time to UTC using Luxon/Day.js. Render a 24-hour horizontal bar for each selected city/timezone. Highlight green for working hours (9 AM - 5 PM), yellow for early/late, red for sleeping.
key_features: Copy shareable URL hash with time configurations

name: Tailwind & CSS Fluid Typography Generator
description: Generates responsive CSS clamp() and Tailwind CSS config utility classes for fluid typography and spacing scaling seamlessly between viewports.
target_audience: Frontend developers, UI/UX designers, and web agencies.

how_to_build.core_logic: Calculate linear interpolation formula: preferred = minSize + (maxSize - minSize) * ((100vw - minViewport) / (maxViewport - minViewport)). Convert to clamp(min, calc(...), max) in rem units.
key_features: Interactive visual viewport scaling preview slider

name: SVG Optimizer & Clean-up Tool
description: Strips useless metadata, editor comments, hidden groups, and converts inline styling in SVG files to minimize file size on the client side.
target_audience: Web developers, UI designers, and performance optimization engineers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Use a compiled browser build of SVGO (SVG Optimizer) or custom DOMParser sanitization rules. Remove <metadata>, comments, XML declarations, unused IDs, and collapse empty groups. Output optimized code + percentage savings.

name: JSON to TypeScript & Zod Schema Converter
description: Instantly parses raw JSON strings and generates strongly typed TypeScript interfaces or Zod validation schemas.
target_audience: TypeScript developers, full-stack engineers, and API integrators.

tech_stack: quicktype-core (browser build) or custom tree walker
how_to_build.core_logic: Parse JSON using JSON.parse(). Recursively traverse objects and arrays. Infer data types (string, number, boolean, array, optional/nullable). Construct TypeScript interface or z.object({...}) code blocks.

name: Conventional Git Commit Message Formatter
description: Interactive form to generate standard Conventional Commits (feat, fix, docs, chore, refactor) with breaking change warnings.
target_audience: Software developers, open-source contributors, and DevOps engineers.

how_to_build.core_logic:
Provide dropdowns for Type (feat, fix, refactor), Scope, Short Summary, Long Description, and Breaking Changes footer. Concatenate into standard format: type(scope): summary

body

BREAKING CHANGE: ....
key_features: Character counter for commit title (50 char rule)

name: OpenGraph (OG) Meta Image & Card Tester
description: Simulates how social media links will render on Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Slack, and Discord without needing public domain deployment.
target_audience: SEO specialists, web developers, content marketers, and bloggers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Accept HTML input or raw meta tag strings. Parse <meta property="og:image">, <meta name="twitter:title">, etc. Extract values and populate pre-styled preview cards matching Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook layouts.

name: Color Blindness Simulator for Web Images
description: Applies SVG accessibility color matrix filters on uploaded images to simulate Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia, and Achromatopsia.
target_audience: UI/UX designers, accessibility (a11y) auditors, and graphic artists.

how_to_build.core_logic: Upload image into Canvas. Apply SVG <feColorMatrix> filter values based on standard color blindness color transformation matrices (e.g., Brettel/Machado algorithms).

name: EXIF Metadata Stripper & Image Sanitizer
description: Removes GPS location coordinates, camera models, dates, and copyright metadata from images before publishing online.
target_audience: Privacy advocates, journalists, social media users, and photographers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Read image file using FileReader API. Draw image to HTML5 Canvas (which strips native EXIF metadata automatically) and export via canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg'), or rewrite binary headers to strip EXIF tags.
key_features: Shows detected EXIF data before stripping

name: CSV & JSON Data Anonymizer
description: Hashes or replaces sensitive user data (Names, Emails, Phone numbers) in CSV/JSON datasets with mock data while preserving structure.
target_audience: Data analysts, software testers, QA engineers, and database administrators.

how_to_build.core_logic: Parse CSV with PapaParse or JSON with JSON.parse(). Allow user to select target columns. Apply SHA-256 hashing, masking (e.g. j***@gmail.com), or synthetic fake data substitution.

name: Offline Base64 Image & Data URI Converter
description: Converts files and images to Base64 data strings and vice versa, completely offline in the browser.
target_audience: Frontend developers, email template developers, and web creators.

how_to_build.core_logic: Use FileReader.readAsDataURL() for File to Base64 encoding. Use Regex parsing and atob() or Blob URLs for Base64 to File decoding.

name: JWT (JSON Web Token) Offline Decoder
description: Decodes and inspects JSON Web Tokens (Header, Payload, Expiration Date) without leaking sensitive Auth tokens to third-party sites.
target_audience: Backend developers, security researchers, and frontend engineers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Split JWT string by '.' into 3 parts (Header, Payload, Signature). Decode Base64Url strings using atob(). Parse JSON payload and format timestamp (exp, iat) into human-readable date strings.

name: PDF Page Organizer & Splitter (WASM)
description: Reorder, delete, rotate, or extract specific pages from PDF documents entirely in the browser using WebAssembly / pdf-lib.
target_audience: Office workers, students, lawyers, and administrative staff.

how_to_build.core_logic: Load PDF via pdfjs-dist to render canvas thumbnails. Allow HTML5 Drag-and-Drop to reorder or delete pages. Reconstruct new PDF document using pdf-lib and output downloadable Blob.

name: Markdown to Rich Text Clipboard Converter
description: Converts Markdown text into formatted Rich Text that pastes perfectly with headings, bold text, lists, and tables into Google Docs or Notion.
target_audience: Content managers, technical writers, bloggers, and project managers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Parse raw Markdown using marked.parse() to output HTML string. Use navigator.clipboard.write() with Blob(['text/html'], {type: 'text/html'}) to write formatted rich text to OS system clipboard.

name: Readability Score & Grade Level Calculator
description: Calculates Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Gunning Fog Index, and Coleman-Liau Index to determine reading age readability.
target_audience: SEO copywriters, marketers, academics, and technical documentation writers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Count total sentences, words, and syllables (using regex patterns for vowel groups). Calculate Flesch Reading Ease score: 206.835 - 1.015*(totalWords/totalSentences) - 84.6*(totalSyllables/totalWords).

name: Client-Side Micro Invoice Generator
description: Simple invoice builder for freelancers with automatic tax calculation, logo upload, and offline PDF generation.
target_audience: Freelancers, contractors, consultants, and small business owners.

how_to_build.core_logic: Maintain line items, quantity, price, discount, and tax rate in state. Compute grand total. Use LocalStorage to save business profile/logo. Render HTML template and export to PDF via jspdf.
key_features: Save company info in local browser

name: ASCII Folder Tree Structure Generator
description: Converts indented folder/file lists into clean ASCII tree structures (├── src / └── index.js) for GitHub Readmes.
target_audience: Developers, technical writers, open-source maintainers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Parse indented text lines into dynamic tree objects based on space/tab indentation level. Recursively output ASCII glyph connectors (├──, └──, │   ).

name: CSS Glassmorphism & Neumorphism Generator
description: Visual UI generator to tweak backdrop blur, transparency, borders, and shadows for modern glass/neumorphic UI elements.
target_audience: UI designers, frontend developers, and web creators.

how_to_build.core_logic: Provide range sliders for backdrop-filter: blur(), background: rgba(), border, and box-shadow. Apply values real-time to preview card and produce CSS snippet.

name: Aspect Ratio & Pixel Dimensions Calculator
description: Calculates missing width/height pixel dimensions based on standard aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 9:16) or custom ratios.
target_audience: Video editors, graphic designers, web developers, and digital marketers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Formula: (New Width / Original Width) * Original Height = New Height. Recalculate dynamically on input change using Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) for simplified ratio reductions.

name: CSS Gradient Generator with Noise Texture
description: Generates modern linear/radial CSS gradients overlaid with subtle SVG noise grain textures.
target_audience: Web designers, frontend developers, and landing page creators.

how_to_build.core_logic: Combine CSS linear-gradient string with a Base64-encoded SVG noise background filter generated via <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise">.

name: Micro-SVG Wave & Section Divider Generator
description: Generates customizable SVG wave curves, slants, and step section dividers for landing page section transitions.
target_audience: Web designers, Tailwind developers, and WordPress builders.

how_to_build.core_logic: Use cubic Bezier curves (d="M 0 100 C ..."). Adjust control point coordinates dynamically using UI sliders for height, waves count, and complexity.
key_features: Copy SVG markup / HTML embed code

name: SEO Text-to-Slug & URL Sanitizer
description: Converts titles or text in multiple languages into clean, SEO-optimized, lowercase, hyphen-separated URL slugs.
target_audience: SEO managers, bloggers, content managers, and developers.

how_to_build.core_logic: Normalize unicode string using String.prototype.normalize('NFD'). Strip diacritical accents, remove special non-alphanumeric characters, convert spaces/underscores to hyphens, and lowercase.
key_features: Stop words filter toggle (a, the, in, and)
